name: Berries ~Kagayaku Kisetsu ga Owaru Mae ni...~
original_name: Berries ～輝く季節が終わる前に…～
source:
Summer. Yuusuke Sugihara runs with a father a family restaurant "BERRIES". One day Yuusuke wakes up and finds a letter on the desk saying that his father went surfing and that Yuusuke should be store manager in his absence. What kind of memories will he gather by the autumn? 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-september-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
盛夏时节，杉原佑介与父亲共同经营家庭餐厅“BERRIES”。一天早晨，佑介醒来后发现桌上留着一封信。父亲说自己外出冲浪了，要他在这段时间担任店长。秋天到来前，佑介将在这里收获怎样的回忆？

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-september-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
